title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_20.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops a metaphysical framework equating time with phenomenal flux rather than objective reality. He argues that perceived time depends entirely on things 'looking different'—a regulator controlled by an external 'He' (identified as the demiurge James-James/Palmer Eldritch). His 3-74 vision revealed both self and world as illusory constructs (Maya); he experienced reversion to Roman Acts-era identity as 'Thomas.' PKD connects this insight to Dogon cosmology's Nommo-Yurugu dialectic and speculates about supernatural intelligence, Jim Pike's murder, and his own house being firebombed as part of a conspiracy.
key_claims: Time is a tautology: the subjective flow-rate of time is merely the rate at which perceived phenomena change; there is no independent temporal clock for the universe.
Astral determinism is a mode of being rooted in ignorance (Maya) regarding our true self and world; it means we are manufactured, controlled entities cut off from authenticity.
The self is a mere 'seeming' (appearance), not substance: in 3-74 PKD experienced his entire self and world revert to Rome AD 45, proving ego is under volitional external control.
The mysterious 'He' is identifiable as the demiurge/master magician (James-James / Palmer Eldritch / YHWH), while redemption comes from a salvific God external to counterfeit reality.
The Dogon cosmology (Nommo-Yurugu dialectic) mirrors the cosmological principle PKD saw in 3-74, pointing to a superior extra-terrestrial intelligence as the source of both theology and technology.
PKD's house firebombing (November 17, 1971) was likely a conspiracy attempt to discredit him, connected to Jim Pike's assassination and efforts to suppress theological material.

tensions: PKD cannot explain how an external 'He' affects either things or the observer—or both; the mechanics remain unclear.
If astral determinism controls everything perceived, how did PKD achieve the freedom to perceive the 3-74 vision at all?
The reversion to Rome AD 45 is 'palpably absurd' (PKD's own admission), yet he claims it happened; he cannot reconcile the paradox with known systems.
PKD is uncertain whether his real identity is 'Thomas' (the Acts-version) or whether 'Thomas' is itself another illusion.
The connection between Jim Pike's alleged murder, the 1971 house hit, and PKD's theological work is speculative; PKD acknowledges the theory is inferential.
PKD alternates between confident theological proclamation and epistemic humility ('I can only speak of my experience').
If Maya is absolute, how can there be an 'unchanging actuality' behind it? PKD concedes the unchanging reality may not have always been unchanged.

uncertainty_flags: The identity of 'He' / 'James-James' is asserted but not definitively established; PKD relies on an 'AI voice' statement.
The mechanism by which an external force 'causes things to look different' is never explained mechanistically.
The claim that the Nov 17, 1971 house hit was part of a conspiracy is speculative, based on hearsay from a lawyer and inferential reasoning.
PKD's assertion that Jim Pike was 'murdered' relies on a single statement from the Sibyl entity; no other evidence is presented.
The Dogon-Sirius connection is treated as confirmation of PKD's 3-74 vision, but the causal direction (did he learn of the Dogon after the vision?) is unclear.
PKD cannot specify what 'world of Acts' replaces astral determinism; he only speaks from his own experience, leaving the generalizability unclear.
The references to folder numbers (folder 21-072, etc.) suggest these are notebook pages, but no metadata links them to other archival material.

Here, the E. of Ph. statement essentially agrees with the AI voice, + is borne out by the EB experiment. In fact, the EB experiment is grotesque because it is not possible to count objects in the hundreds in ten seconds - so what really happened? Either the subject imagined he counted in the hundreds or - well, it's absurd, like a dream. Reality itself, including the subject, is abolished, he is not counting at all. This proves that lacking the regulator of "things looking different" he would have no time sense - not just a faulty one but none. Time would cease, + with it reality as we know it. Simply things looking different. But (as I say) since this looking different is the sole regulator, without which time ceases, then flow-rate is only a tautology for rate at which things look different, + what is this rate measured against? If it speeds up, what does it speed up in relation to? Or if it slows down, in relation to what? Clearly the things looking different is the sole arbiter, + is not in relation to any other standard. The EB speaks of "history accelerating" - + this at an accelerating rate... The approach of the climax foreseen intuitively by the prophet is being felt, + feared, as a coming event. Its imminence is, today, not an article of faith; it is a datum of observation + experience. Well, this accelerating acceleration is being measured against clock time - but if clock time were also accelerating, + at an accelerating rate, I say we would not know. Then we assume time has reverted - obviously. But has it? Things have reverted to a prior looking, but does look = are (esse)? Obviously not.
